frames.label: Day 2 · day 2 00:00
events: Mara went to sleep at the harbor inn.

Mara would now say of themself: I am here on the island now, and the first day felt like I was moving through it half-awake. I walked a lot and saw places but no one. That is not how I work. I do things with my hands and I listen to people. Tomorrow I will push past the quiet.; now wants Find someone who needs hands and skills, and start building a reputation for getting work done.; now fears That I came to the wrong place or that the island does not need what I can offer.; with strangers is now I warm up fast when I meet them face to face, but today I did not meet anyone to warm up to.; takes advice I listen and then I do what I was going to do anyway. I heard nothing new today.

Mara reflected: I walked the island today looking for work and a place to build. Visited the harbor, market square, smithy, quarry, tavern, and Rope Lane. Saw the layout and some empty lots where building might happen. No one was at most places or they didn't stop to talk. I bought bread twice and slept at the inn. Two nights left paid. Still looking for who runs things here and where I fit in.
